image_description: A cylindrical, brass-cased marine-style barometer sitting on a wooden surface. The instrument features a top-mounted circular dial with a glass cover and a secondary vertical face on the cylinder body, also with a dial and markings. The casing has decorative rivets or studs along the vertical edges.
